articles.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
articles.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

articles.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
articles.summary: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

articles.title: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal physics never seen in nature
articles.summary: A new model suggests Mars may host ice-forming physics never directly observed before.
